query_plan.query: What is the combined area of all continents in square kilometers?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by continent and sum the areas in square kilometers.
steps.query: Return all continents and their areas in square kilometers, with their continent id and continent name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT SUM(continents.area_km2) AS combined_area FROM continents

s1.sql_query: SELECT continents.continent, continents.area_km2, continents.name FROM continents
